entry.title: US envoys arrive in Ukraine for talks after meeting Putin in Russia
entry.summary: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on Sunday, having "discussed substantive plans for next steps" with Putin on Saturday, according to the White House.

entry.title: Majority Russian-speaking city in Ukraine considers language ban in the arts
entry.summary: Ukraine's third-biggest city Odesa decides this week whether to ban Russian-language content in music and literature in public.

entry.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
entry.summary: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

entry.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
entry.summary: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

entry.title: Taylor crowns boxing career in stylish Croke Park triumph
entry.summary: Katie Taylor ends illustrious career as a three-time undisputed world champion as Croke Park gave one of Ireland's greatest sporting figures the grandest of farewells.

entry.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
entry.summary: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

entry.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania
entry.summary: Andrew and Tristan Tate are currently in a Miami jail fighting extradition to the UK over separate charges and deny all the allegations.

entry.title: Volkswagen board approves plan to cut another 50,000 jobs
entry.summary: The group - which includes Audi, Porsche, Skoda as well as the VW brand - plans to cut a total of 100,000 posts by 2030.

entry.title: Ukrainian quits college team over Russian signing
entry.summary: Ukrainian Kate Koval says she left Louisiana State University's basketball programme because of the team's decision to sign a Russian player.

entry.title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
entry.summary: Rescuers found 44 survivors on board the vessel but bad weather meant they had to leave five bodies behind.

entry.title: Embattled Spanish PM insists no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis
entry.summary: Spain's prime minister tells parliament it is absurd to think the government knew and did nothing, after thousands join protests in Spanish cities.

entry.title: Burnham and Macron agree to scale up action on small boats
entry.summary: The leaders also discussed Ukraine and "the UK's drive to get closer to Europe", No 10 says.

entry.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
entry.summary: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

entry.title: Rosenberg: Putin's veiled threat to UK part of Russia's campaign against West
entry.summary: The Russian president wants to keep Britain guessing - and stressing - over Moscow's real intentions.

entry.title: 'Humble but ambitious' - the return of fallen giants Schalke
entry.summary: One of Germany's fallen giants, Schalke are back in the Bundesliga after a complicated few years.

entry.title: Why did Modi urge Putin to end Ukraine war - and will he listen?
entry.summary: BBC correspondents in Delhi and Moscow look at why the Indian PM made a very public peace plea to his Russian ally.

entry.title: 'She slipped out of my hand' - children missing after ferry sinks off northern Cyprus
entry.summary: Ayten and Hayri Bicer's two young children are among 20 missing in an incident that killed eight people.

entry.title: Belugas and dolphins rescued from closed Canadian park arrive in Spain
entry.summary: Two beluga whales and four dolphins rescued from a struggling Canadian marine park arrived in Spain as part of an effort to relocate the animals and avoid euthanasia.

entry.title: Moment tornado tears through southern France
entry.summary: The tornado has injured more than 40 people and destroyed homes in villages.

entry.title: Is UK's Storm Shadow missile a game changer for Ukraine?
entry.summary: Correspondent Joe Inwood breaks down the weapons technology that could make a difference in the Russia-Ukraine war.

entry.title: Why is Ukraine's ex-defence minister calling for wartime elections?
entry.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov has called for elections, without addressing concerns over how they could be held while at war.

entry.title: BBC visits smouldering Kyiv market after Russian strikes
entry.summary: Six people were injured in the strike on the market selling second-hand records, posters, toys and tools.

entry.title: Moment €9m worth of art stolen from Italy museum
entry.summary: Police released the CCTV footage after the art, which was stolen in March, was recovered.
